guarantees.claim: When flush_st is FlushIdle and process_i is asserted, flush_st_d becomes FlushPacker; otherwise flush_st_d remains FlushIdle.
When flush_st is FlushPacker and packer_flush_done is asserted, flush_st_d becomes FlushFifo; otherwise flush_st_d remains FlushPacker.
When flush_st is FlushFifo and fifo_empty_o is asserted, flush_st_d becomes FlushClear and msgfifo_flush_done is set to 1; otherwise flush_st_d remains FlushFifo.
When flush_st is FlushClear and clear_i passes prim_mubi_pkg::mubi4_test_true_strict, flush_st_d becomes FlushIdle; otherwise flush_st_d remains FlushClear.
For any undefined flush_st state, flush_st_d is forced to FlushIdle.
guarantees.cond: flush_st not in {FlushIdle, FlushPacker, FlushFifo, FlushClear}

guarantees.claim: msgfifo_flush_done is driven to 0 at the top of the always_comb block and is set to 1 only when flush_st is FlushFifo and fifo_empty_o is true.

assumptions.claim: clear_i must eventually be driven to a true mubi4 value (passing mubi4_test_true_strict) so the FSM can leave FlushClear state.
assumptions.risk: If clear_i remains false or invalid, the FSM deadlocks in FlushClear, preventing subsequent processing and blocking the flush handshake indefinitely.

assumptions.claim: packer_flush_done and fifo_empty_o must accurately report completion of their respective operations; these signals are produced outside this chunk.
assumptions.cond: when the FSM waits in FlushPacker or FlushFifo
assumptions.risk: If these indicators are asserted prematurely or glitch, the FSM may advance before the underlying flush is finished, potentially leaving data or state inconsistent.

uncertain_points.claim: msgfifo_flush_done is a combinational pulse that appears only when flush_st is FlushFifo and fifo_empty_o is true; external logic must capture it synchronously before the next clock edge.
uncertain_points.risk: If the done pulse is too narrow or sampled incorrectly, the external controller may miss the flush completion event, leaving the interface stalled or misaligned.

uncertain_points.claim: The FSM asserts msgfifo_flush_done upon entering FlushClear, before the clear_i acknowledgment is handled; it is unclear whether the external environment expects flush done after the clear phase.
uncertain_points.cond: flush sequence transition from FlushFifo to FlushClear
uncertain_points.risk: The external controller might deassert process_i or start new operations on receipt of done, while the clear_i handshake is still pending, potentially leaving the FIFO partially cleared or causing a protocol race.

uncertain_points.claim: If flush_st becomes an illegal value (e.g., due to a soft error), the default case silently resets the FSM to FlushIdle, aborting any ongoing flush without an error signal.
uncertain_points.risk: A silent abort could drop a security-critical flush or wipe sequence before it completes, leaving internal state uncleared and possibly leaking sensitive data.
